answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 41679 Country: United States of America Title: Is it haram to put on cream/lotion that contains alcohol in it Question: Is it haram to put on cream/lotion that contains alcohol in it? Answer ID: 41679 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1432/1432/M=1433) If such cream or lotion does not contain alcohol prepared by haram ingredients then there is no harm in applying the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
